leadText:
The rock hunters (Japanese: 岩石ハンター rock hunters) are a group of characters of the day that appeared in Sparking Confusion!.

They appeared on Akala Island at Wela Volcano Park, where they were hunting for Spark Stones, in the process disrupting the feeding rituals of the and living there. After one of them lost a battle to Kiawe's Marowak, they went inside a nearby cave. They were attacked while inside, but ended up being found by , Kiawe, and after Kiawe suggested they should see what the hunters were up to. The hunters told them that they were attacked while mining for more Spark Stones. When they saw the assailant, an Alolan , they ran away.
